name: comfyui
description: ComfyUI image generation, local only, vendored (maic vendor add comfyui; see docs/vendor.md)

artifacts.name: outputs
artifacts.description: generated images/videos (embed prompts unless --disable-metadata) and saved story replies

artifacts.name: workflows
artifacts.description: your saved workflows, editable (ComfyUI's user workflow folder points here)

artifacts.name: templates
artifacts.description: your own templates: originals shown in ComfyUI's template browser and opened as copies, never edited in place

artifacts.name: builtin-templates
artifacts.description: ComfyUI's shipped templates (a pip package, read-only, replaced on upgrade); copy one into templates/ to make it yours

artifacts.name: temp
artifacts.description: previews and intermediates (also cleared by ComfyUI on start)
